learned_rules.situation: When an agent outputs format instructions, field specifications, or system prompts instead of actual content in those fields
learned_rules.reason: The taxonomy defines B.1 as when the Coordinator provides ambiguous, inconsistent, or incomplete task specifications. An agent echoing back input format instead of producing substantive output indicates confusion about what the task actually requires, which is fundamentally a task specification problem originating from the Coordinator.
learned_rules.not_code: Don't confuse with B.2 or other Solver-execution errors - when the Solver literally doesn't know what to produce (evidenced by reproducing instructions), the fault lies in how the task was specified, not in the Solver's analysis capabilities
